decisions.reason: s0014 reads 博平; with Dongchang, Shen, and the Grand Canal in the surrounding units this is Boping in Shandong, not Boxing (博興). The proposed replacement is accurate.
The same focus unit has 博平; literal Boxing misidentifies the place. Boping restores the correct toponym without other changes.
s0082 has 許州; Xuzhou would be 徐州. The idiomatic already has Xuchang, and s0083’s raid on 許 confirms the Henan prefecture. The proposed literal fix is correct.

s0101 is only 十五年 after an established Guangxu sequence (s0099–s0100); ‘of his reign’ wrongly casts Zhang Zhiwan as the reigning emperor. Dropping that phrase matches the source and parallel year phrasing.
s0129 has 瞻對; s0130 calls it 蜀門戶, which fits Zhantui/Nyarong on the Sichuan–Kham frontier, not Dromo/Chumbi. Zhantui is the accurate repair.
